children: Chinese President Xi Jinping called for intensified search and rescue efforts, a swift investigation and accountability measures after a deadly fire broke out aboard a foreign cargo vessel undergoing repairs at a shipyard in the eastern city of Qingdao, state news agency Xinhua reported.
The fire that occurred at about 11:15 a.m. resulted in significant casualties, Xinhua said, without providing further details.
